title: Skew tolerance: fires inside the elicited window are onTime; outside record cronSkewed with delta
asA: operator observing the timeliness of scheduled work on a Worker
iWant: the dispatcher to classify every fire against the elicited skew window and record cronSkewed for late fires with the delta
soThat: the applied logging companion surfaces cron drift as a first-class signal without every handler having to keep its own clock

acceptanceCriteria.description: With skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock aligned to scheduledTime, dispatching a scheduled event fires cronFired with {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome: onTime, duration: >=0} on the sink; no cronSkewed event fires for that dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher configured with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock aligned to scheduledTime
acceptanceCriteria.then: a cronFired event fires with outcome onTime and no cronSkewed fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: With skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock advanced 60000ms past scheduledTime, dispatching a scheduled event fires cronSkewed with {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome: skewed, duration: >=0, deltaMs: 60000} on the sink; the routed handler still runs to completion.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher configured with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock advanced 60000ms past scheduledTime
acceptanceCriteria.then: a cronSkewed event fires with the observed delta and the handler still runs
